Parameters derived from mathematical formulas and economic models.

### Total Annual Decentralized Framework for Drug Assessment Operational Costs: $40M {#sec-dfda_annual_opex}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

Total annual Decentralized Framework for Drug Assessment operational costs (sum of all components: $15M + $10M + $8M + $5M + $2M)

**Inputs**:

- [Decentralized Framework for Drug Assessment Maintenance Costs](#sec-dfda_opex_platform_maintenance): $15M (95% CI: $10M - $22M)
- [Decentralized Framework for Drug Assessment Staff Costs](#sec-dfda_opex_staff): $10M (95% CI: $7M - $15M)
- [Decentralized Framework for Drug Assessment Infrastructure Costs](#sec-dfda_opex_infrastructure): $8M (95% CI: $5M - $12M)
- [Decentralized Framework for Drug Assessment Regulatory Coordination Costs](#sec-dfda_opex_regulatory): $5M (95% CI: $3M - $8M)
- [Decentralized Framework for Drug Assessment Community Support Costs](#sec-dfda_opex_community): $2M (95% CI: $1M - $3M)

$$
\begin{gathered}
OPEX_{dFDA} \\
= Cost_{platform} + Cost_{staff} + Cost_{infra} \\
+ Cost_{regulatory} + Cost_{community} \\
= \$15M + \$10M + \$8M + \$5M + \$2M \\
= \$40M
\end{gathered}
$$

**Methodology**: [../appendix/dfda-impact-paper#opex-breakdown](../appendix/dfda-impact-paper#opex-breakdown)

*✓ High confidence*

### Trial Capacity Multiplier: 12.3:1 {#sec-dfda_trial_capacity_multiplier}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

Trial capacity multiplier from DIH funding capacity vs. current global trial participation

**Inputs**:

- [Annual Global Clinical Trial Participants](#sec-current_trial_slots_available) 📊: 1.90M patients/year (95% CI: 1.50M patients/year - 2.30M patients/year)
- [Patients Fundable Annually](#sec-dih_patients_fundable_annually) 🔢: 23.4M patients/year

$$
\begin{gathered}
k_{capacity} = \frac{N_{fundable,ann}}{Slots_{curr}} = \frac{23.4M}{1.9M} = 12.3 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } N_{fundable,ann} \\
= \frac{Subsidies_{trial,ann}}{Cost_{pragmatic,pt}} \\
= \frac{\$21.7B}{\$929} \\
= 23.4M \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Subsidies_{trial,ann} \\
= Treasury_{RD,ann} - OPEX_{dFDA} \\
= \$21.8B - \$40M \\
= \$21.7B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } OPEX_{dFDA} \\
= Cost_{platform} + Cost_{staff} + Cost_{infra} \\
+ Cost_{regulatory} + Cost_{community} \\
= \$15M + \$10M + \$8M + \$5M + \$2M \\
= \$40M \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Treasury_{RD,ann} \\
= Funding_{treaty} - Payout_{bond,ann} - Funding_{political,ann} \\
= \$27.2B - \$2.72B - \$2.72B \\
= \$21.8B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{treaty} \\
= Spending_{mil} \times Reduce_{treaty} \\
= \$2.72T \times 1\% \\
= \$27.2B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Payout_{bond,ann} \\
= Funding_{treaty} \times Pct_{bond} \\
= \$27.2B \times 10\% \\
= \$2.72B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{treaty} \\
= Spending_{mil} \times Reduce_{treaty} \\
= \$2.72T \times 1\% \\
= \$27.2B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{political,ann} \\
= Funding_{treaty} \times Pct_{political} \\
= \$27.2B \times 10\% \\
= \$2.72B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{treaty} \\
= Spending_{mil} \times Reduce_{treaty} \\
= \$2.72T \times 1\% \\
= \$27.2B
\end{gathered}
$$

*✓ High confidence*

### Total DALYs from Elimination of Efficacy Lag Plus Earlier Treatment Discovery from Higher Trial Throughput: 565B DALYs {#sec-dfda_trial_capacity_plus_efficacy_lag_dalys}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

Total DALYs averted from the combined dFDA timeline shift. Calculated as annual global DALY burden × eventually avoidable percentage × timeline shift years. Includes both fatal and non-fatal diseases (WHO GBD methodology).

**Inputs**:

- [Global Annual DALY Burden](#sec-global_annual_daly_burden) 📊: 2.88B DALYs/year (SE: ±150M DALYs/year)
- [Eventually Avoidable DALY Percentage](#sec-eventually_avoidable_daly_pct): 92.6% (95% CI: 50% - 98%)
- [dFDA Average Total Timeline Shift](#sec-dfda_trial_capacity_plus_efficacy_lag_years) 🔢: 212 years

$$
\begin{gathered}
DALYs_{max} \\
= DALYs_{global,ann} \times Pct_{avoid,DALY} \times T_{accel,max} \\
= 2.88B \times 92.6\% \times 212 \\
= 565B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } T_{accel,max} = T_{accel} + T_{lag} = 204 + 8.2 = 212 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } T_{accel} \\
= T_{first,SQ} \times \left(1 - \frac{1}{k_{capacity}}\right) \\
= 222 \times \left(1 - \frac{1}{12.3}\right) \\
= 204 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } T_{first,SQ} = T_{queue,SQ} \times 0.5 = 443 \times 0.5 = 222 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } T_{queue,SQ} = \frac{N_{untreated}}{Treatments_{new,ann}} = \frac{6{,}650}{15} = 443 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } N_{untreated} = N_{rare} \times 0.95 = 7{,}000 \times 0.95 = 6{,}650 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } k_{capacity} = \frac{N_{fundable,ann}}{Slots_{curr}} = \frac{23.4M}{1.9M} = 12.3 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } N_{fundable,ann} \\
= \frac{Subsidies_{trial,ann}}{Cost_{pragmatic,pt}} \\
= \frac{\$21.7B}{\$929} \\
= 23.4M \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Subsidies_{trial,ann} \\
= Treasury_{RD,ann} - OPEX_{dFDA} \\
= \$21.8B - \$40M \\
= \$21.7B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } OPEX_{dFDA} \\
= Cost_{platform} + Cost_{staff} + Cost_{infra} \\
+ Cost_{regulatory} + Cost_{community} \\
= \$15M + \$10M + \$8M + \$5M + \$2M \\
= \$40M \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Treasury_{RD,ann} \\
= Funding_{treaty} - Payout_{bond,ann} - Funding_{political,ann} \\
= \$27.2B - \$2.72B - \$2.72B \\
= \$21.8B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{treaty} \\
= Spending_{mil} \times Reduce_{treaty} \\
= \$2.72T \times 1\% \\
= \$27.2B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Payout_{bond,ann} \\
= Funding_{treaty} \times Pct_{bond} \\
= \$27.2B \times 10\% \\
= \$2.72B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{treaty} \\
= Spending_{mil} \times Reduce_{treaty} \\
= \$2.72T \times 1\% \\
= \$27.2B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{political,ann} \\
= Funding_{treaty} \times Pct_{political} \\
= \$27.2B \times 10\% \\
= \$2.72B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{treaty} \\
= Spending_{mil} \times Reduce_{treaty} \\
= \$2.72T \times 1\% \\
= \$27.2B
\end{gathered}
$$

*? Low confidence*

- [Status Quo Average Years to First Treatment](#sec-status_quo_avg_years_to_first_treatment) 🔢: 222 years
- [Trial Capacity Multiplier](#sec-dfda_trial_capacity_multiplier) 🔢: 12.3:1

= \$21.8B - \$40M \\
= \$21.7B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } OPEX_{dFDA} \\

### Patients Fundable Annually: 23.4M patients/year {#sec-dih_patients_fundable_annually}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

Number of patients fundable annually at dFDA pragmatic trial cost ($1,200/patient). Based on empirical pragmatic trial costs (RECOVERY to PCORnet range).

**Inputs**:

- [Annual Clinical Trial Patient Subsidies](#sec-dih_treasury_trial_subsidies_annual) 🔢: $21.7B
- [dFDA Pragmatic Trial Cost per Patient](#sec-dfda_pragmatic_trial_cost_per_patient) 📊: $929 (95% CI: $97 - $3K)

$$
\begin{gathered}
N_{fundable,ann} \\
= \frac{Subsidies_{trial,ann}}{Cost_{pragmatic,pt}} \\
= \frac{\$21.7B}{\$929} \\
= 23.4M \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Subsidies_{trial,ann} \\
= Treasury_{RD,ann} - OPEX_{dFDA} \\
= \$21.8B - \$40M \\
= \$21.7B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } OPEX_{dFDA} \\
= Cost_{platform} + Cost_{staff} + Cost_{infra} \\
+ Cost_{regulatory} + Cost_{community} \\
= \$15M + \$10M + \$8M + \$5M + \$2M \\
= \$40M \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Treasury_{RD,ann} \\
= Funding_{treaty} - Payout_{bond,ann} - Funding_{political,ann} \\
= \$27.2B - \$2.72B - \$2.72B \\
= \$21.8B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{treaty} \\
= Spending_{mil} \times Reduce_{treaty} \\
= \$2.72T \times 1\% \\
= \$27.2B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Payout_{bond,ann} \\
= Funding_{treaty} \times Pct_{bond} \\
= \$27.2B \times 10\% \\
= \$2.72B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{treaty} \\
= Spending_{mil} \times Reduce_{treaty} \\
= \$2.72T \times 1\% \\
= \$27.2B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{political,ann} \\
= Funding_{treaty} \times Pct_{political} \\
= \$27.2B \times 10\% \\
= \$2.72B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{treaty} \\
= Spending_{mil} \times Reduce_{treaty} \\
= \$2.72T \times 1\% \\
= \$27.2B
\end{gathered}
$$

**Methodology**: [../economics/1-pct-treaty-impact#funding-allocation](../economics/1-pct-treaty-impact#funding-allocation)

*✓ High confidence*

Number of diseases without effective treatment. 95% of 7,000 rare diseases lack FDA-approved treatment (per Orphanet 2024). This is the 'queue' of diseases waiting for cures.

= N_{rare} \times 0.95 \\
= 7{,}000 \times 0.95 \\
= 6{,}650

### Status Quo Average Years to First Treatment: 222 years {#sec-status_quo_avg_years_to_first_treatment}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

Average years until first treatment discovered for a typical disease under current system. The average disease is in the middle of the queue, so it waits half the total queue clearance time (~443/2 = ~222 years).

**Inputs**:

- [Status Quo Queue Clearance Time](#sec-status_quo_queue_clearance_years) 🔢: 443 years

$$
\begin{gathered}
T_{first,SQ} = T_{queue,SQ} \times 0.5 = 443 \times 0.5 = 222 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } T_{queue,SQ} = \frac{N_{untreated}}{Treatments_{new,ann}} = \frac{6{,}650}{15} = 443 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } N_{untreated} = N_{rare} \times 0.95 = 7{,}000 \times 0.95 = 6{,}650
\end{gathered}
$$

**Methodology**: [@status-quo-cure-timeline-estimate]

*? Low confidence*

#### Sensitivity Analysis

### Status Quo Queue Clearance Time: 443 years {#sec-status_quo_queue_clearance_years}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

Years to clear entire queue of diseases without treatment. At current rate of ~15 diseases/year getting first treatments, the queue of ~6,650 would take ~443 years to completely clear.

**Inputs**:

- [Diseases Without Effective Treatment](#sec-diseases_without_effective_treatment) 🔢: 6.65k diseases
- [Diseases Getting First Treatment Per Year](#sec-new_disease_first_treatments_per_year) 📊: 15 diseases/year (95% CI: 8 diseases/year - 30 diseases/year)

$$
\begin{gathered}
T_{queue,SQ} = \frac{N_{untreated}}{Treatments_{new,ann}} = \frac{6{,}650}{15} = 443 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } N_{untreated} = N_{rare} \times 0.95 = 7{,}000 \times 0.95 = 6{,}650
\end{gathered}
$$

**Methodology**: [@status-quo-cure-timeline-estimate]

*? Low confidence*

dFDA pragmatic trial cost per patient. Uses ADAPTABLE trial ($929) as DELIBERATELY CONSERVATIVE central estimate. Harvard meta-analysis of 108 trials found median of only $97/patient - our estimate may overstate costs by 10x. Confidence interval spans meta-analysis median to complex chronic disease trials.

<script>
// Conservative lazy loading: only load images actually in viewport
(function() {
  'use strict';
  
  let imageObserver = null;
  let loadTimeout = null;
  
  function enableLazyLoading() {
    const images = document.querySelectorAll('img');
    
    // Use Intersection Observer with conservative threshold
    // rootMargin: '50px' means only load images within 50px of viewport
    // This prevents loading images passed through during hash navigation
    imageObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries, observer) => {
      entries.forEach(entry => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting && entry.intersectionRatio > 0) {
          const img = entry.target;
          // Only load if image is actually visible (not just passed through)
          if (img.dataset.src) {
            img.src = img.dataset.src;
            img.removeAttribute('data-src');
          } else if (!img.hasAttribute('loading')) {
            // For images without data-src, use native lazy loading
            img.setAttribute('loading', 'lazy');
          }
          observer.unobserve(img);
        }
      });
    }, {
      rootMargin: '50px',  // Only load images within 50px of viewport
      threshold: 0.01      // Trigger when at least 1% visible
    });
    
    images.forEach(img => {
      imageObserver.observe(img);
    });
  }
  
  // Handle hash navigation (clicking links to sections)
  // Delay loading to avoid loading images passed through during jump
  function handleHashNavigation() {
    if (loadTimeout) clearTimeout(loadTimeout);
    // Wait 300ms after navigation to let scroll settle
    // Images will load naturally via Intersection Observer when visible
    loadTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
      // Scroll has settled, Intersection Observer will handle visible images
      // No action needed - observer is already watching
    }, 300);
  }
  
  // Initialize on page load
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', enableLazyLoading);
  } else {
    enableLazyLoading();
  }
  
  // Handle hash changes (clicking anchor links)
  window.addEventListener('hashchange', handleHashNavigation);
  
  // Also handle initial hash if page loads with one
  if (window.location.hash) {
    setTimeout(handleHashNavigation, 100);
  }
})();
</script>
